description: Create unified API service layer for editor tools. Postman collection reveals backend endpoints for filters, stickers, and soundfx. Build dedicated service files following the soundFXService and musicLibraryService patterns: list/search/get methods, proper error handling, field normalization, response wrapping. Services: filterLibraryService (GET /public/filters), stickerEmojiService (GET /public/stickers), captionsService (POST /reels/auto-caption), and ensure voiceoverService and cameraService exist and work correctly.
steps: Review existing filterLibraryService.ts — if incomplete, enhance it to match soundFXService pattern: export listFilters(), getFilterById(), searchFilters() with proper response handling
Review existing stickerEmojiService.ts — if incomplete, enhance it: export listStickers(), getStickerById(), searchStickers() following same pattern
Create captionsService.ts in src/api/services/: export captionServices.autoCaption(reelId: string, videoUri: string) calling POST /reels/auto-caption
Review existing voiceoverService.ts — ensure it exports recordVoiceOver() and handles audio URI storage
Review existing cameraService.ts — ensure photo/video capture methods are present

Ensure all services handle: (1) skipAuth: true for public endpoints, (2) response field normalization (id/_id, title/name), (3) structured error returns with ApiResponse<T>, (4) console logging for debugging
acceptance_criteria: filterLibraryService.ts exports listFilters(), getFilterById(), searchFilters() using GET /public/filters
stickerEmojiService.ts exports listStickers(), getStickerById(), searchStickers() using GET /public/stickers
captionsService.ts exports autoCaption() using POST /reels/auto-caption with proper request/response shape
All services use ApiResponse<T> interface and normalize response fields
All services skip auth (skipAuth: true) for public endpoints
No TypeScript errors, all exports are typed
verification: TypeScript compilation: npm run lint or npm run build
Each service file compiles without errors
Services can be imported into tool panels without type errors
findings: Successfully implemented all required service layer enhancements. Created captionsService.ts with autoCaption() and batchAutoCaption() methods following soundFXService pattern. Enhanced stickerEmojiService.ts with consistent skipAuth: true for all public endpoints. Verified filterLibraryService.ts, voiceoverService.ts, and cameraService.ts all follow the pattern with proper ApiResponse<T> typing, field normalization, and error handling. All services export both named and default exports. No TypeScript errors.
